blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp on Wednesday criticized the House prosecution panel and the Senate majority for dropping three of the four impeachment articles against her, saying the move had wasted millions of pesos in public funds. Duterte spokesperson Paolo Panelo Jr. issued the statement after the prosecution withdrew Articles I, III and IV, leaving allegations of unexplained wealth and failure to disclose assets as the only remaining grounds for the vice president’s impeachment trial. In a statement, Panelo noted that 20 total trial days were spent on Articles I and IV—which dealt with allegations of misuse of […]...
